note: Scripted capture sessions for LightMem-Ego. Each session stands in for 44 seconds of glasses video: one text frame every frame_interval_s seconds (what the camera shows) and the speech that ASR would return. Scenes get distinct frame colours so the upstream OpenCV event detector splits them as it would split real scene changes. Two questions are asked at the end, while the capture is still running. The first needs something seen more than 30 seconds earlier, outside the rolling current window. The second is a follow-up whose pronoun only resolves through the first exchange. 'summary' and 'expect' are for the judge and the metrics only and never reach the system.
